53.  RISIKO TINGKAT SUKU BUNGA                            53.  INTEREST RATE RISK

      Risiko tingkat suku bunga terjadi dari bermacam-macam             Interest rate risk arises from various banking products
     layanan   perbankan   kepada   nasabah    meliputi           provided to customers including deposit taking (demand
     penghimpunan dana (antara lain  giro, tabungan, dan            deposits, saving deposits, and time deposits), lending
      deposito), penempatan dana (antara  lain  kredit yang             (loans),  commitments  and  contingencies,  and  other
      diberikan), komitmen dan kontinjensi, serta instrumen lain           earning instruments.
     yang mengandung suku bunga.

     Asset Liability Committee (“ALCO”) Bank CIMB Niaga         Bank CIMB Niaga’s Asset Liability Committee (“ALCO”),
     yang beranggotakan  Direksi dan beberapa anggota          which consists of the Board of Directors and selected
     manajemen    senior,   bertanggung   jawab   dalam         members  of  senior management,  is  responsible  for
     menetapkan kebijakan dan strategi pengelolaan risiko           determining  interest  rate  risk management  policy and
      tingkat suku bunga di banking book serta mengawasi            strategies   in   banking  book  and   monitoring    its
     penerapan dan pelaksanaannya. Tujuan utama ALCO           implementation and  execution. The main  objective  of
     adalah mengoptimalkan hasil usaha Bank CIMB Niaga        ALCO  is to optimise Bank CIMB Niaga’s return within
     dengan  tetap memperhatikan  batasan-batasan  risiko           predetermined risk limits.
     yang ditetapkan.

      Selain  itu, risiko tingkat bunga dapat pula terjadi dari             In addition, interest rate risk could also arise from treasury
     produk-produk   tresuri  seperti  surat  berharga  dan           products   like  marketable   securities  and   derivative
      transaksi-transaksi derivatif yang terdapat pada portofolio            transactions included in trading book portfolio. Besides
      trading book. Selain menggunakan pendekatan faktor           using    sensitivity   factor   approach   (“DV01”),   the
       sensitivitas  (“DV01”), pengukuran  risiko  tingkat suku          measurement of interest rate risk in trading book, has also
     bunga pada trading book juga telah dilakukan dengan           using more sensitive measurement method on market risk,
     menggunakan metode pengukuran  risiko pasar yang             that is VaR (Value at Risk).
      lebih risk sensitive yaitu VaR (“Value at Risk”).

     Market Risk Committee (“MRC”) secara berkala mengkaji         The Market Risk Committee (“MRC”) continuously do test
     ulang   tingkat   risiko  pada   portofolio   tresuri  dan              for risk in treasury portfolio and determined the policy,
     menetapkan kebijakan, batasan-batasan perdagangan            trading limits that can be accepted and interest rate risk
     yang dapat diterima  serta  strategi manajemen  risiko         management  strategy  on  trading  book  based  on
      tingkat bunga pada trading book berdasarkan prinsip             prudentiality principle.
      kehati-hatian.
